title: Import a Next.js folder
intro: Copy a folder into a new cloud project. Prepare the site and open its preview separately.
sharing: Environment and private files are excluded. Only choose a copy you have cleared for sharing.
unsupported: Folder selection is not supported in this browser. Use a desktop browser that supports choosing folders.
unavailable: New imports are unavailable here. You can still check a previous import or open its saved project.
name: Project name
needsFolder: Choose the same folder to resume. Its file names, bytes and hashes must match the saved review.
uncertain: The result is not confirmed. Check progress before sending more files. An unresolved upload may need cancellation.
cancelPending: Cancellation requested. Keep checking until the server confirms it. If creation already finished, the saved project is kept.
canceled: This import is closed. You can review another folder.
complete: Source files copied. Site preparation and preview have not started.
failed: This step could not finish. Your saved import request is kept.
blocked: Resolve these files in your copy, then choose the folder again.
recoveryStorage: Browser recovery storage is unavailable or invalid. No new request will be sent.
changed: This folder does not match the saved review. Choose the original copy or cancel the saved import.
limits: Up to 400 files and 64 MiB total. Media files: 32 MiB each. Text files: 750,000 bytes each; inline manifest: 700,000 bytes.
